note: design-only note for task #876 (genome streaming render reader). No production code, no version bump, no ABI change.

capability: open a store to a forward reader position with O(1) resident state, deriving no catalog
compiled: srmech_genome_reader_open(dir, the_one, leaf_dim, ws, ws_len, cursor*)
reentrant: by construction (caller arena, no file-scope statics)

capability: find — advance to the next region whose CAP BYTES ALONE satisfy a predicate
wire: predicate is a STRUCT not a callback -> no new typedef -> ABI stays 6

capability: ride — stream a region's turns, uncoupling each through the_one, folding a harvest op, stopping early when satisfied
wire: harvest is an ENUM not a callback
note: rc280's targeted node_ids read re-expressed as a ride-termination condition, not a separate seek path

capability: skip — advance past the current region without riding it (stride only, no decode)
enter-ride-exit — bracketed unit; exit positioned at the next cap; folds the region digest; fires the 101 tick at the exit
cancel: SRMECH_CANCELLED=7 at a chromosome boundary; returns a resumable partial + cursor

capability: verify — maintain the region-chain accumulator over exactly the bytes traversed
honest_bound: equals the head body_sha256 only after a COMPLETE traversal; a partial traversal is a verified-PREFIX value comparable to nothing stored

finding: cold-open time is dominated by the BLOCK WALK (~66% of _catalog_data), not by region hashing or array materialisation (~5.7%)
consequence: streaming instead of materialising the catalog buys MEMORY (O(P)->O(1)) and EARLY EXIT, not much wall time on a full pass — do not oversell it

investigation: _section_node_ids on __vocab__ raises GenomeBoundingError ('declares 23 node_ids but only 0 are present ... the section is malformed'). The vocab chromosome carries the SAME 0x6B kernel telomere as a plasmid section but holds a raw Klein-4 byte blob, not a 89 graph payload. Every consumer excludes it by string comparison against VOCAB_LABEL
verdict: a real format gap — a reader classifying by cap kind cannot distinguish them and hard-errors

why: every reader entry takes ws from the start (no file-scope statics, reentrant by construction) and the reader never calls srmech_genome_section_counts

holds_because: self-describing blocks: kind byte + leaf_dim gives the stride
per-leaf reversible quad_turn coupling: any prefix decodes to the corresponding symbol-stream prefix
region-leading cap integrity: a prefix pays the SAME bound as a whole-region read
fails_because: a cap carries NO region length, so region boundaries are discoverable only by walking
random_access_cost: O(body) for one, O(N*body) for N without a resident catalog — a GENUINE failure of the no-index position
decided_by: fermata F1 (the query workload, not derivable from the brief)

proposal: carry a uint64 big-endian next_region_delta in the cap's post-label-NUL padding, the same slot 127 active-telomere count and 135/rc281 gene copy-number already use
effect: a find sweep becomes O(P) seeks of leaf_dim bytes (~15.4 MB touched) instead of a 336 MB traversal; random access becomes O(P) not O(body)
back_compat: all-NUL padding reads as delta 0 = 'unknown, stride instead', so every existing store stays readable
write_cost: genome_append already knows region_len at write time
framing: derived-in-place, NOT a stored plaintext TOC — the distinction ADR-0003 actually draws
status: ONE CANDIDATE — a format addition and therefore a conductor decision, not a design conclusion
